News Release – Vancouver, British Columbia – TheNewswire - September 1, 2026 – Anonymous Intelligence Company Inc. (CSE: ANON) (OTC: ANICF) (FRANKFURT: 1JI0) (the “Company” or “ANON”), a leader in privacy-focused artificial intelligence and decentralized technologies, is pleased to announce that further to its news release dated August 4, 2026, it has closed an additional 10% equity interest in ARKHIVE Technologies Ltd. (“ARKHIVE”), increasing the Company’s aggregate ownership interest in ARKHIVE  to 20%.

Pursuant to the supplemental strategic investment agreement dated July 6, 2026, the Company acquired an additional 100,000 common shares of ARKHIVE, representing an additional 10% of the issued and outstanding shares of ARKHIVE. As consideration for the additional interest, 800,000 common shares (the “Consideration Shares”) were issued to ARKHIVE at a deemed price of $0.25 per share, representing aggregate deemed consideration of $200,000.
Following closing, the Company holds an aggregate of 200,000 common shares of ARKHIVE, representing 20% of the issued and outstanding shares of ARKHIVE.
The Consideration Shares are subject to a statutory hold period of four months and one day from the date of issuance.

The increased investment builds upon ANON’s continued expansion into blockchain technology and further strengthens the strategic relationship between ANON and ARKHIVE. It also provides the Company with a significant equity interest in ARKHIVE as the parties continue to advance ARKHIVE’s technology and pursue global commercial opportunities.
In connection with the Company’s investment in ARKHIVE, Denis Franks, Chief Executive Officer of ANON, was appointed to the board of directors of ARKHIVE effective August 4, 2026.

Antoine Lavoie, President and CEO of ARKHIVE, commented, “Mr. Franks brings extensive executive leadership experience and significant knowledge of blockchain technology, including experience in the launch of several cryptocurrencies. His appointment provides ANON with board-level representation in ARKHIVE and further aligns the interests of our two companies as we continue to advance our respective technology and commercial objectives.”
For more information on ARKHIVE, visit: Arkv.io.  To trade the ARKHIVE Token, visit: Trade.Arkv.io
For more information about ARKHIVE founder, Antoine Lavoie, along with ARKHIVE’s partnership with ANON, read the recent Forbes article.
“This 20-Year-Old CEO Is Building Trust Into Web3, Not Hype,”

ANONYMOUS INTELLIGENCE COMPANY INC.
Denis Franks
